tasks.typecheck: deno check main.ts src/*.ts scripts/*.ts tests/*.ts
tasks.check: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task typecheck && deno task test
tasks.package:service: rm -rf dist/service-bundle && mkdir -p dist/service-bundle dist/release && cp -R service/. dist/service-bundle/ && cp LICENSE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md dist/service-bundle/ && tar -czf dist/release/dsh-mac-intel-service.tar.gz -C dist/service-bundle . && cd dist/release && shasum -a 256 dsh-mac-intel-service.tar.gz > dsh-mac-intel-service.tar.gz.sha256
tasks.build:macos:x86_64: deno task prepare-build && rm -rf dist/macos/x86_64/DSH-Intel.app && deno desktop --include src/ui --include assets --permission-set=app --target x86_64-apple-darwin --icon assets/DSH-Intel.icns --output dist/macos/x86_64/DSH-Intel main.ts && mkdir -p dist/macos/x86_64/DSH-Intel.app/Contents/Resources && cp LICENSE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md README.md README.en.md dist/macos/x86_64/DSH-Intel.app/Contents/Resources/ && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/macos/x86_64/DSH-Intel.app
tasks.package:macos:x86_64: deno task build:macos:x86_64 && mkdir -p dist/release && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent dist/macos/x86_64/DSH-Intel.app dist/release/DSH-Intel-macos-x86_64.zip && cd dist/release && shasum -a 256 DSH-Intel-macos-x86_64.zip > DSH-Intel-macos-x86_64.zip.sha256
